messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary pipeline (canary-service) detected elevated 5xx rate + tokenization-errors for model artifact tag 'v2.3.0' on /generate — anomalous outputs and latency spike. Auto-cutover prevented but canary failing. paging: miguel_oncall
miguel_oncall: seeing ~9% 5xx on canary slice, and customers getting truncated tokens. taking a look.
elaine_prod: noticed user reports of garbled assistant replies and broken punctuation — possible tokenizer mismatch with weights.
sara_infra: logs show artifact-service propagated tag 'v2.3.0' but weightset metadata shows 'weights:v2.2.9' on some hosts — suspect tag-propagation race / artifact-shadowing.
miguel_oncall: start mitigation plan: 1) flip model routing FF to block v2.3.0 2) rollback canary -> v2.2.9 3) cut traffic from affected gateway pools. who's doing the FF flip?
dave_release: I can flip flag, which flag name?
ryan_rt: flag is model_routing_allow_v2_3_0 (prod). Use the job in ops-console or curl below.
dave_release: running curl now:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/flags/model_routing_allow_v2_3_0 -d '{"value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```
dave_release: done — flag set to false :thumbsup:
incident-bot: ACTION: Feature flag model_routing_allow_v2_3_0 set to false by dave_release at 1799991302
miguel_oncall: confirm canary traffic to v2.3.0 dropped to 0% on routing logs.
elaine_prod: canary requests now hitting v2.2.9, error rate falling to baseline. customer impact clearing.
customer_ops: currently two mid-market customers (acme-corp, beta-startup) reported noisy outputs during window 1799991220-1799991280. No data exfiltrated. escalation level: P2.
sara_infra: initiating rollback pipeline for the release shard group to pin to weights:v2.2.9. patch job queued.
miguel_oncall: confirming rollback job:
```
./deployctl rollback --cluster=release-shard-A --model-tag=v2.2.9 --force
```
miguel_oncall: rollback started. ETA ~3m.
ryan_rt: observed tokenization mismatch traces on gateway-7 and -8 — clearing KV caches as part of rollback.
dave_release: rollback succeeded on shard A at 1799991401. monitoring.
elaine_prod: post-rollback health: 5xx now stable at 0.5%, tokens normal, latency back to baseline.
customer_ops: notified impacted customers, offered incident summary and mitigation actions. no customer complaints after rollback.
miguel_oncall: root cause hypothesis: artifact registry returned stale weightset mapping due to a recent artifact shadowing race in the tag propagation service. it allowed an incompatible tokenizer-to-weight pairing to be promoted with v2.3.0.
sara_infra: opened follow-up issue infra#5623 to add strict metadata validation on publish and to add canary precheck for tokenizer/weights hash equality. assigning to dave_release for release process improvements.
dave_release: will add a blocking validation to release pipeline and plan a hotfix for artifact-service next week.
ryan_rt: handing off to oncall-next (elaine_prod) for the postmortem and customer comms. attaching logs and trace links: https://logs.internal/1799991234
elaine_prod: oncall-next acknowledged. postmortem owners: elaine_prod, sara_infra, dave_release. ETA for draft: EOD.
miguel_oncall: closing pager. nice work everyone :coffee:
